events.verdict: Vucevic (ORL) exits the paint within three seconds.
Capela (HOU) brings one hand to the opposite side of Vucevic's (ORL) body in the post, but he immediately removes it.
Green (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Fournier (ORL) and does not deliver contact.
Fournier (ORL) makes contact to the arm of Harden (HOU) that affects his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Tucker's (HOU) arm is not perfectly vertical but his arm is moving back into a legal position when he absorbs the marginal contact with Gordon's (ORL) arm during the driving shot attempt.
Gordon (ORL) takes fewer than three steps after he has gathered the ball.
Gordon (ORL) does not impede Rivers (HOU) during the rebound.
Rivers (HOU) makes marginal contact with Ross' (ORL) body during the rebound.
Tucker (HOU) places a hand/arm to the front of Augustin (ORL) on the drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
[Observable in Enhanced Video] Ross (ORL) lifts his pivot foot.
Vucevic (ORL) could be deemed to be in the lane for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Green (HOU) briefly grasps the jersey of Augustin (ORL) but doesn't affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
